newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade to sell two seats on bolsa Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade to sell two seats on bolsa Nov 21.

text.p: Venezuelan State Deposits Guarantee Fund Fogade is to auction two seats on the Caracas stocks exchange on Nov 21 for a base price of 145 million bolivars ($309,000) each, Fogade said.
Potential bidders have until Nov 19 to register for the two seats, numbers 30 and 48, and prepay a 10 percent deposit.

Fogade successfully sold two seats on the exchange for 400 million bolivars ($860,000) on September 26. The sales are part of Fogade's program to sell off assets it received in exchange for financial aid during the 1994-5 financial crisis.
